test_description: Optimizer iteration cap — supply max_iters in {0, -5, 1, 20} and verify iterations_executed <= max_iters (or invalid max_iters<=0 rejected)
input_contract: max_iters <= 0 rejected or executes 0 steps; max_iters >= 1 strictly caps iterations_executed <= max_iters
independent_oracle: Hard budget invariant: iterations_executed <= max(0, max_iters)

expected.iteration_cap: max_iters<=0 rejected or 0 iters; max_iters=1 -> <=1 iter; max_iters=20 -> <=20 iters
